cmd:

mkdir -p c/real
cat > c/real/r-1.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "r-1", "target": "synthetic", "kind": "bash-unit", "cmd": "echo '{}'", "checks": [{"type": "exit_code", "equals": 0}]}
CASEEOF
EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --case nonexistent-case-xyz >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{"code":%s}' $?
